sources.title: RTX 5070 12GB Local LLM (2026): Fastest 12GB, ~59 tok/s
sources.snippet: The best local LLM for the RTX 5070 is Qwen3.5 9B Instruct at ~53 tok/s on its 12GB VRAM. A 14B model at Q4 runs at ~7 tok/s with CPU offload.

sources.title: Run Qwen 3.5 Locally: The Model That Beats GPT-5 Nano on Your Own Hardware
sources.snippet: The headline number: Qwen 3.5 9B outperforms last-generation Qwen 3 30B — a model 3x its size — on multiple benchmarks. That's the kind of efficiency gain that makes local AI practical for normal people, not just researchers with GPU clusters.
